title: Record HORUS as an internal analytic agent, not a separate session
problem: The R05 berth-allocation report names HORUS in its review trail, which could be misread as an independently opened ChatGPT conversation or an external peer review.
failure: A role label alone can obscure whether the review came from a separate conversation, external provider, or an internal analytic agent.
correction: The R05 development log records HORUS as an internal analytical collaboration agent reviewing an exact candidate head. It states that this was not a separate provider conversation and no provider session ID exists. Describe that execution channel plainly and do not attribute the review to Gold Lab methodology.
transfer: For every review claim, record the actual participant and channel, exact reviewed head, and genuine session identifier only when available. Distinguish internal model-side analysis from a separate session and from human peer review.
limits: This is provenance for the R05 berth-buffer study only. It does not establish a general review protocol, validate the math by itself, or imply HORUS reviewed the Gold Lab.
author: R05 development record; TOTO
